The primitives delineate the sharp phase transition between sustainable exponential growth (G>0), certain ruin (G<0), and erratic behavior at the boundary (G=0). Asymptotic optimality ensures that no other strategy can outperform Kelly in the long run, while the optimality of the fixed-fraction rule justifies sequential application even when probabilities shift. These results form the foundational 'unified lens' for resource allocation across GSI, GSE, and broader stochastic control.
